ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE regions (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(100) NOT NULL, parent_id INT, level ENUM('country','province','city','district'), FOREIGN KEY (parent_id) REFERENCES regions(id))
description: 地区表，存储国家、省份、城市、区县等地理层级信息

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE addresses (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, user_id INT, region_id INT, detail VARCHAR(255), is_default BOOLEAN DEFAULT FALSE, created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id), FOREIGN KEY (region_id) REFERENCES regions(id))
description: 用户地址表，存储用户的收货地址信息

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE order_status_history (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, order_id INT, status ENUM('created','paid','shipped','delivered','cancelled','refunded'), changed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id))
description: 订单状态历史表，记录订单状态变更历史

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE payments (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, order_id INT, payment_method ENUM('alipay','wechat','credit_card','paypal'), amount DECIMAL(10,2), payment_status ENUM('pending','success','failed'), paid_at TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id))
description: 支付表，记录订单的支付信息

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE refunds (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, payment_id INT, refund_amount DECIMAL(10,2), refund_reason VARCHAR(255), refunded_at TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (payment_id) REFERENCES payments(id))
description: 退款表，记录订单的退款信息

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE product_variants (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, product_id INT, sku_code VARCHAR(100) UNIQUE, color VARCHAR(50), size VARCHAR(50), price DECIMAL(10,2), stock INT DEFAULT 0, FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id))
description: 产品变体表，存储产品的不同规格（如颜色、尺寸）

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE inventory_logs (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, variant_id INT, change_type ENUM('in','out','adjust'), quantity INT, changed_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (variant_id) REFERENCES product_variants(id))
description: 库存日志表，记录产品变体的库存变更历史

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE suppliers (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(200), contact_email VARCHAR(150))
description: 供应商表，存储产品供应商信息

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE product_suppliers (product_id INT, supplier_id INT, PRIMARY KEY (product_id, supplier_id), FOREIGN KEY (product_id) REFERENCES products(id), FOREIGN KEY (supplier_id) REFERENCES suppliers(id))
description: 产品供应商关联表，建立产品与供应商的多对多关系

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE promotions (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, name VARCHAR(200), discount_type ENUM('percentage','fixed'), discount_value DECIMAL(10,2), start_date DATE, end_date DATE)
description: 促销活动表，定义各种促销活动的规则

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE order_promotions (order_id INT, promotion_id INT, PRIMARY KEY (order_id, promotion_id), FOREIGN KEY (order_id) REFERENCES orders(id), FOREIGN KEY (promotion_id) REFERENCES promotions(id))
description: 订单促销关联表，记录订单应用的促销活动

ddl_statement: CREATE TABLE user_events (id INT PRIMARY KEY AUTO_INCREMENT, user_id INT, event_type ENUM('view','add_to_cart','search','purchase'), target VARCHAR(255), created_at TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP, FOREIGN KEY (user_id) REFERENCES users(id))
description: 用户事件表，记录用户在平台上的各种行为事件
